Five-grid comics,The author column says "CunKai"

The first frame: Scene: Classroom, Characters: Xiao Ming, Xiao Hong, Dialogue: Xiao Ming (secretly looking at Xiao Hong): (thinking in my heart) Xiao Hong is so cute, I must find a chance to confess to her.

Scene: Classroom hallway, Characters: Xiao Ming, Xiao Gang, Dialogue: Xiao Gang: Xiao Ming, why are you always absent-minded recently? Is there something on your mind? Xiao Ming: Ah, you found out, I fell in love with Xiao Hong.

Third Space: Scene: Playground, Characters: Xiao Ming, Xiao Hua, Dialogue: Xiao Hua: Xiao Ming, be brave, go and confess to Xiao Hong! Xiao Ming: But I'm afraid of being rejected, what should I do?

Fourth Space: Scene: Library, Characters: Xiao Ming, Xiao Hong, Dialogue: Xiao Ming (hands Xiao Hong a love letter): Xiao Hong, this is for you, please tell me what you think after reading it. Xiao Hong (blushes): Okay, I'll read it carefully.

Scene: Classroom, Characters: Xiao Ming, Xiao Hong, Dialogue: Xiao Hong (laughs): Xiao Ming, I promise to be your girlfriend, let's work together! Xiao Ming (excited): Really? That's great, I'll be good to you!
